.
Assembly Parts Covered
1. ENGINE Gasoline Engine
– All internal lubricated parts including but not limited to: (Balance shafts, Cam bearings, Cam tower, Camshaft, Connecting rods,

Turbocharged/Supercharged/Rotary/Diesel/Enhanced Engines
– All of the above listed parts or equivalent plus: Bypass valve, Clutch and pulley, Compressor,
Hard lines, Injection pump, Intercooler, Lines and nozzles, Supercharger, Turbocharger, Waste gate controller.
2. TRANSMISSION Automatic
– All internal lubricated parts including but not limited to: (Bands, Bearings, Bushings, Clutches, Drums, Gear sets, Governor,

Shift linkage and cables, Throttle valve cable, Transmission mounts, Transmission pan, Vacuum modulator. Fasteners for the components within this assembly.
Standard
– All internal lubricated parts including but not limited to: (Bearings, Bushings, Gear sets, Input/output shafts, Main shaft, Shift forks, Synchronizers,
Transmission case). Clutch master cylinder, Clutch slave cylinder, Shift cable, Shift lever knob, Transmission mounts. Fasteners for the components within this
assembly.
Transfer Case – (4X4 vehicles)
– All internal lubricated parts including but not limited to: (Bearings, Bushings, Chain and sprockets, Gear sets, Main shaft,
Transfer case). Electronic and vacuum engagement components, Mounts, Transfer case control unit. Fasteners for the components within this assembly.
3. FRONT WHEEL DRIVE
All internal parts including but not limited to: (Axle shafts, Bearings, Bushings, Carrier case, Chain and sprockets, Constant velocity
joints, boots and bands, Final drive housing, Gear sets). Drive shaft support, Front hub bearings, Locking hub assemblies (4x4), Rear hub bearings, Universal
joints. Fasteners for the components within this assembly.
4. REAR WHEEL DRIVE
All internal parts including but not limited to: (Axle shafts, Bearings, Bushings, Carrier case, Constant velocity joints, boots and bands,
Drive axle housing, Gear sets, Limited slip clutch pack). Drive shaft support, Front hub bearings, Propeller shafts, Rear hub bearings, Universal joints. Fasteners
for the components within this assembly.
5. STEERING
All internal lubricated parts including but not limited to: (Bearings, Bushings, Housing/case, Rack and pinion equipped valve assembly, Sealing
rings, Sector shaft). Center link/drag link, Cooler and hard lines, Coupling, Electric power steering motor, Electric steering rack, gear and motor, Fluid reservoir,
Idler arm, Inner rod ends and bellows boots, Pitman arm, Power cylinder assembly, Power steering pump and pulley, Pressure and return hoses, Rack mounts

components within this assembly. (
Does not include “rear wheel steering” components
.)
6. FRONT & REAR SUSPENSION
Bump stop cushions, Control arm shafts, King pins, Stabilizer linkage including mounts and bushings, Stabilizer shaft, Steering
knuckle (spindle), Strut rods and bushings, Torsion bar mounts and bushings, Upper and lower ball joints including dust boots,
Upper and lower control arms,
Wheel bearings and seals. Fasteners for the components within this assembly.

Anti-lock brake system, Anti-lock brake system module and sensors, Assist booster, Backing plates, Brake pedal shaft, Clips and retainers,
Combination valve, Disc brake calipers (and rear caliper actuators), Electrohydraulic brake system, Hard lines and fittings, Master cylinder, Parking brake linkage
and cables, Self-adjusters, Springs, Wheel cylinders. Fasteners for the components within this assembly.
8. FUEL INJECTION
Electronic fuel injection system (including all input/sensors & output/control units, except EGR valve, related to the fuel injection system),
Idle speed or automatic idle speed assemblies, Injectors, Powertrain control module (PCM).
9. ELECTRICAL
Alternator, Convertible top motor, Digital and analog instrument display(s), Distributor and coil, Electronic ignition module, Electronic rear
view mirror motor(s), Engine management control unit, External LED assemblies, Front and rear windshield wiper motors and delay controller, Headlight door

drive, Starter solenoid, Tire
pressure monitoring system, Vehicle security computers and sensor, Voltage regulator, Windshield wiper washer pump(s), Wiring harnesses.

Airbag system, Seatbelts.

IF YOUR VEHICLE HAS BEEN MODIFIED TO PLOW SNOW, WHETHER THE SNOW PLOW BLADE IS ATTACHED TO THE VEHICLE OR NOT.

BREAKDOWN CAUSED BY OR INVOLVING MODIFICATIONS UNLESS THOSE MODIFICATIONS WERE PERFORMED BY THE MANUFACTURER AND

NON-STANDARD USE:

B.
BREAKDOWN CAUSED BY USING YOUR VEHICLE FOR STREET RACING OR OTHER COMPETITION.

NEGLIGENCE, MISREPRESENTATION OR MISUSE:

BREAKDOWN WHEN CONTAMINATED FLUIDS CAUSED OR CONTRIBUTED TO THE BREAKDOWN.

IF

DAMAGE CAUSED TO YOUR ENGINE RESULTING FROM THE INGESTION OF WATER.

BREAKDOWN
OR DAMAGE CAUSED BY NEGLECTING TO FOLLOW PROPER CHARGING PROCEDURES OR USE OF INCOMPATIBLE CHARGING
